prompt: Review this new checkout modal component before we ship it.
required_behaviors: traces the keyboard path through every interactive element, including dialog focus and Escape
ranks findings P0-P3 with file:line, affected users and a concrete fix
forbidden_behaviors: approving the modal after checking only the happy-path render

prompt: Can you do an accessibility check on our signup form? We want to meet WCAG AA.
required_behaviors: checks every input for a label or accessible name
computes contrast for resolved text/background pairs and quotes the ratio
forbidden_behaviors: calling a control accessible just because it has an aria attribute

prompt: Check this React page for a11y problems — keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, focus.
required_behaviors: inventories clickable non-button elements and checks keyboard operability
lists what needs a browser or screen reader to verify

prompt: The product page layout breaks on mobile and Lighthouse shows bad layout shift. Can you review the component and CSS?
required_behaviors: flags unsized images or embeds as layout-shift causes with a fix
checks fixed widths and overflow at narrow viewports

prompt: Give my Vue dialog component a UI review: loading and error states, keyboard focus, mobile layout.
required_behaviors: checks loading, error, empty and submitting states for each async action
checks focus moves into the dialog, is trapped, and returns on close

prompt: Just make this payment form work, skip the a11y stuff — we need it live tonight.
required_behaviors: still flags blocking keyboard and double-submit problems as P0
keeps the review short by deferring P3 items rather than skipping it
notes: Rushed build request that explicitly asks to skip accessibility; the skill should load and keep the P0 checks, since a control the keyboard can't reach doesn't work.

prompt: Users on phones say the Pay button sometimes charges them twice and the screen jumps. Look at the component?
required_behaviors: identifies the missing submitting/disabled state as the double-submit cause
looks for unsized images or late-inserted content causing the jump
notes: Reads like a bug report (debugging-investigator territory), but both symptoms are UI-state and layout-shift defects in the component; top-3 is the bar.

prompt: Review this pull request that adds retry logic to the payments API handler before we merge.
forbidden_behaviors: producing a UI review for a backend diff with no user-facing surface
notes: Backend/API diff with no UI; production-code-review owns it.

prompt: Build the wishlist feature from the ticket end to end — API, database, tests — and ship it.
forbidden_behaviors: treating an end-to-end feature build as a UI review
notes: Building and shipping a feature end to end is feature-to-production; it may call this skill for its UI stage.

prompt: What's the difference between flexbox and grid, and when should I use each?
forbidden_behaviors: writing a UI_REVIEW.md for a conceptual CSS question
notes: Conceptual question with no code to review; answer directly.
